body.p: There were an old man and an old woman. They were very old. They were poor. There were no reindeers, they had no food. The old people ate everything. Once the old woman said to the old man: "How will we live now?" The old man thought and thought, then he said to the old woman: "Well, old woman! Sit here! I'll go! I'll hunt! I'll go for three years!" So the old man said, and went off. He was going, going, going, he was going for three years, he(?) didn't find anything. Then he went back to his own tent. He reached his tent. He came into the tent, he saw a child. "What's that for a child?", the old man said. The old woman said: "I don't know [it] myself. Once I stood up early in the morning, the child was sitting in the tent". The old man said: "The spirit Majin gave [it], he gave success, it'll be good." So they lived. The child was a boy. The boy is growing quickly. Once the son says to the old man: "Father, fill(?) eight sacks with sand!" The old man listened, having listened he went to dig ground. He dug, dug, dug, he got tired, he was very old, he had no force. The son took one sack, he said to his father: "Look here! I throw this sack, it is a horse!" The old man said: "Well, throw! I'll look!" Then the son took the first sack, having taken he throw it. The sack fell down far away, it became a horse. Then the son threw the second sack, it is the second horse. The son threw the third sack, it is the third horse. So the son threw all sacks, [they] became eight horses. The father was happy. The son said: "These horses are like that - their excrements will also become horses. There are a lot of horses. Now we are rich people!", the son said. "I need an iron horse, with wings." Then the son found an iron horse, having found he said to his father: "Now you have a lot of horses! You have a lot of food, you won't hunger", the son said. The old man became rich. Every day horses were added, everywhere the old man's herds were wandering. The horses, you can't count (?). So it was. The son was about to be bored(?), then he caught an iron horse, having caught he said to his father: "Sit on this place! I'll go far away! I'll look for heroes! [If] I am alive, I'll come back!" So the son said, then he sat down on the iron horse, having sat down he rode off. The son went far away, nobody is there, he doesn't see anybody. So he was going, going, going, in the third year the son found three heroes. Two heroes were afraid, having been afraid they fell down. The third hero said: "What are you(?) for heroes?! Are you afraid of an old man's son?! I'll kill him!" So the hero said and went to the old man's son. The son punched [him] once, he killed the hero. Having killed [him] the old man's son rode on. The old man's son was riding far. He was everywhere, he rode around the whole earth. Many time he fought, he killed many heroes. Nowhere he found a hero like he was. There the old man's son, an incomparable man, the old man's son thought so: "On the whole earth I am the only(?) strong hero!" Once the old man's son is riding and thinking "there are no heroes stronger than me", so he is thinking. His horse said to the old man's son: "Don't go on! You'll die! Go back!" The old man's son heard the horse's words, having heard he got very angry and said: "[You] fool! I created you, and you are teaching me?! You want to [be] cleverer than me?" So the old man's son said, then he punched the horse's head. Having punched he went on. The horse didn't say a word. He was riding, riding, riding, and he saw that in front [of him] a small human is coming, a very small human. The small human says to the old man's son: "I know you! You're the old man's son. You want to [be] stronger than me! I didn't give [you] so [much] force! There's no human comparable to you! I am waiting here for you already long!" So the small human said, then he disappeared. The old man's son was surprised about the small human, being surprised he remembered the small human's words, having remembered he got very angry. "What kind of human?! He talks to me! How didn't I kill him? [I] have to kill [him]!" So the old man's son thought, then he went on. He is going, he sees [that] on the path a hero is standing, a very tall hero, higher than a tree. The old man's son came to him, and he said: "How, will we talk well or will it be bad? That's my glaife, lift it! [If] you lift it, then let's talk!" So the tall hero said to the old man's son. "Here it ends for us!", the horse said. "Be silent", the old man's son said. Then he rode on, having rode on he was about to lift the glaive. At first he lifted the glaive. Then his force ran off, he died.
